definition_senses: Matrix.PosSemidef M = Hermitian M AND nonnegative quadratic form on finitely supported real coordinate vectors. On finite Fin d these represent all coordinate vectors; it is NOT entrywise nonnegativity.
Matrix.PosDef M = Hermitian M AND strictly positive quadratic form on each nonzero finitely supported real vector. This result is produced, not a binder.
Matrix.IsHermitian M = M conjugate-transpose equals M; over real numbers star is identity, so this is actual symmetry.
Source I<=A<=kappa I is represented by PosSemidef(A-I) and PosSemidef(kappa I-A); scalar action on identity is the actual diagonal kappa matrix, not elementwise matrix order.

The rotated actual precision is O diagonal((kappa+1)/2+(kappa-1)cos(theta_i)/2) Otranspose. Neither scalar interval bounds, diagonal positivity, orthogonality equations, inverse facts nor Gaussian regularity are supplied as extra assumptions.
